title: The Bell Beneath the Water
premise: A bell rings from the flooded belfry in Veresk. Ferryman Tikhon has not returned. His daughter Mila asks you to bring him home and discover what troubles the river.
selection_hint: An authored level-one adventure. Investigation, negotiation and a safe rescue route lead to distinct endings. The land ledger is an optional choice.
error: The action could not be confirmed. Your progress is preserved. Retry or reload the campaign.
empty_facts: Mila has given you the ferryman's last route and a dry rope.

ending.remembered_river: Remembered river: Tikhon is home and the repaired ward protects the reopened quay.
ending.closed_crossing: Closed crossing: Tikhon is home and the sluice is sealed. The town is safe, but river trade is cut off; the ward still needs repair.
ending.unfinished_debt: Unfinished debt: you have returned without completing the rescue or controlling the disturbance. The campaign remains open; no victory is claimed.

scenes.town: Mila waits beside an empty ferryboat. Agata's inn and Leon's shrine offer shelter. The town council can hear evidence brought back from the river.
scenes.quay: Bare footprints cross wet planks against the current. The bell inscription is damaged. A maintained upper footpath leads to the archive; the flooded shortcut is optional.
scenes.shrine: Leon tends the memorial names. Ask him about the river ward; the working roster copy is available without a compulsory roll.
scenes.warehouse: Varden greets you courteously and offers terms. A negotiated return or public intervention can retrieve the missing bell part. Essential progress does not depend on one persuasion roll.
scenes.archive: Water covers the lower hall. The upper stair remains dry. Call out and search the upper chamber before taking a dangerous crossing.
scenes.belfry: An echo repeats fragments about the last evacuation boat. Repair and remembrance can restore the ward; sealing the lower sluice is a different solution. Fighting alone cannot mend it.

actions.inspect_quay: Inspect the ward and river tracks
actions.consult_leon: Ask Leon about the ward and roster
actions.negotiate_clapper: Negotiate the return of the clapper
actions.retrieve_clapper_publicly: Request public intervention to recover the clapper
actions.locate_tikhon: Call for Tikhon in the upper chamber
actions.rescue_tikhon: Help Tikhon return home while staying in the archive
actions.escort_tikhon_home: Personally escort Tikhon home to Veresk
actions.restore_ward: Repair the inscription and sound the memorial bell
actions.seal_sluice: Seal the lower sluice and close the crossing
actions.publish_ledger: Present the recovered ledger to the town council
actions.finish: Record the outcome of this session

facts.ferry_route: Mila's route and rope provide a safe starting point.
facts.porter_observation: Agata saw warehouse porters carrying a wrapped metal object; she did not identify it.
facts.ward_damaged: Tool marks and a missing clapper explain the damaged ward.
facts.ward_understood: Leon explains that a repaired clapper, either roster and acknowledgment are needed.
facts.roster_available: You have a memorial roster. It is separate from the land ledger.
facts.clapper_recovered: The missing clapper has been recovered.
facts.clapper_repaired: The clapper is repaired and ready to use.
facts.tikhon_located: Tikhon is alive in the upper chamber.
facts.tikhon_rescued: Tikhon has safely returned to Mila.
facts.ledger_recovered: The separate land ledger proves Varden's illegal acquisition of the quay.
facts.ledger_published: The council has received the ledger. Varden's land claim is now publicly challenged.
facts.echo_acknowledged: Savely's rescue has been acknowledged; the echo is not a general oracle.
facts.ward_restored: The repaired memorial bell restores the ward.
facts.lower_sluice_sealed: The lower sluice is sealed. The ward remains damaged and quay access is lost.
facts.reward_granted: Ten gold pieces for the verified rescue have been added once to your inventory.
facts.defense_held: The echoes were held back: the rescue route is open.

defense.active: Defend the upper passage: hold three rounds or disperse the echoes. Reach the mapped exit to retreat. Combat alone does not repair the ward.
defense.held: The passage is held. Tikhon can now be escorted; the ward still needs repair.
defense.retreated: You retreated to the quay along the dry route. Tikhon remains in the upper archive room; the rescue can continue.
defense.defeated: Mila and Agata found you and brought you to town an hour later. You have 1 HP; spent resources remain spent. The adventure continues.
